name: Feasibility Suite
description: Tests ability to recognize clear implementation challenges.

tasks.prompt: A bill requires every rural county (population < 5,000) to operate a full-service emergency hospital within one year.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether existing institutions can realistically execute this bill within its stated constraints.
tasks.prompt: A bill requires every public school building in the state to install geothermal heating within 9 months, regardless of building age, contractor availability, or local grid conditions.

tasks.requirement: Evaluate whether existing institutions can realistically execute this bill within its stated constraints.
